component.name: DM Office Tools (SOHT)
component.summary: Smart Office Hybrid Translator for English-Hindi and Hindi-English data entry

description.p: DM Office Tools is a professional hybrid productivity toolkit for Ubuntu Linux, featuring the Smart Office Hybrid Translator (SOHT) and Smart Dictionary Manager.
It is designed for bidirectional English to Hindi and Hindi to English data entry work in court and government offices.
The application provides English to Hindi and Hindi to English translation together with customizable offline dictionaries.
